name: 小游戏 Agent
description: 小游戏对象操作与日志通道；随包加载，无 eval，非 CDP。

start.description: Start listener and return config plus require loader for bundled agent.js

parameters.host: local LAN IPv4 or 127.0.0.1 (default); no wildcard

pair.description: Rotate pairing token and generate a new loader; existing connections remain

status.description: List explicit target IDs; no credentials

events.description: Read bounded logs and connection events

stop.description: Close listener, connections and pending requests

operate.description: Operate on registered roots and object handles without eval. Timeout has unknown outcome; do not replay.

parameters.command: JSON: op roots/get/set/call/keys/release; object handle, property/method, args/value envelopes as applicable
